questions.stem: Chlorine has two isotopes: Cl-35 (75% abundance) and Cl-37 (25% abundance). What is the relative atomic mass of chlorine?
questions.explanation: Relative atomic mass is calculated as a weighted average: Ar = (35 x 75 + 37 x 25) / 100 = (2625 + 925) / 100 = 3550 / 100 = 35.5. The answer is closer to 35 because Cl-35 is more abundant.
